page_title: BOC 1-1 HEI | Bochum v Heidenheim 13/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Here is a change. Tim Kleindienst is going off and Frank Schmidt gives the last tactical orders to Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim).

90+5' Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum) bangs in a header at goal from near the penalty spot after a decent cross, but it lacks power and accuracy and spins well past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' 1 - 1 The score has changed – 1:1. Kevin Stoger sends a fantastic cross into the box from the corner. Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) jumps highest and plants a header into the top right corner.
90' Corner kick. Kevin Stoger (Bochum) is ready to send the ball into the box.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jan-Niklas Beste trots off the pitch and is replaced by Marnon Busch (Heidenheim).
89' Frank Schmidt decides to make a substitution. Eren Dinkci will be replaced by Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim).
89' A cross from Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bochum.
87' The goal by Bochum is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a handball.
85' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) makes a rough challenge and Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle for a foul.
83' Patrick Osterhage comes off the pitch to be replaced by Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum).
83' Heiko Butscher has decided to substitute Takuma Asano and he is replaced by Maximilian Wittek (Bochum).
82' A substitution has been made. Felix Passlack goes off and Tim Oermann (Bochum) comes on.
82' 0 - 1 Own goal! Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) suffers a good deal of misfortune as he accidentally puts a pass from one of the attacking players into his own net. The score is 0:1.
79' Takuma Asano (Bochum) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
74' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
72' Substitution. Matus Bero makes his way off the pitch and Lukas Daschner (Bochum) comes on as his replacement.
72' Heiko Butscher has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) replacing Philipp Hofmann.
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) will replace Kevin Sessa.
71' The possession of the ball – 63:37.
67' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bochum.
66' Some neat passing and movement from Heidenheim as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
63' The Bochum players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Patrick Ittrich signals NO GOAL following the VAR review.
63' Wait! Referee Patrick Ittrich immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was a handball in the build-up play.
63' Goal! Takuma Asano (Bochum) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:0.
61' Takuma Asano (Bochum) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the crossbar to safety.
60' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
58' What was Matus Bero (Bochum) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
56' Kevin Muller pulls off a great save to deny Takuma Asano (Bochum), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
54' Bochum take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

54' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Takuma Asano (Bochum). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. The ball goes out of play. Bochum are awarded a corner kick.
52' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Anthony Losilla (Bochum) was quite harsh and Patrick Ittrich didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
50' Neat passing move from Bochum in order to create new attacking opportunities.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Bernardo (Bochum) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Heidenheim due to a handball in the build-up play.
44' The goal for Heidenheim is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.
43' Goal! Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
42' Bochum quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
39' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) bursts into the box and latches on to a pin-point long through ball, but one of the defenders steps in to clear the ball to safety.
38' A perfect long pass by Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) finds Eren Dinkci. He latches on to the pass and continues his attacking run.
35' Felix Passlack (Bochum) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
34' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Philipp Hofmann (Bochum), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.

32' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
28' Bernardo (Bochum) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Kevin Muller.

25' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) launches himself at the ball from the free kick and produces a header which lacks accuracy, sending it just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
24' Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle for a foul after Matus Bero (Bochum) hacks down one of his opponents. That's a free kick to Heidenheim.
23' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play. Heidenheim will have a throw-in.
21' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance towards the bottom left corner, but Manuel Riemann is alert and makes a decent save.
18' A lofted pass finds Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
17' Heidenheim work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
16' The Bochum players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

13' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) collects a wonderful lead pass and creates some space to smash the ball goalwards from long range. His shot goes painfully close to the right post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
12' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Bochum for a penalty. Play continues.
9' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Heidenheim comes to nothing. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.

6' That's a well-taken pass by Takuma Asano (Bochum). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
5' Bochum can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
2' The foul by Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) was seen by Patrick Ittrich who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The referee of today's match will be Patrick Ittrich.
